start.title: La Voce dall'Alto
start.text:
Dio ti parla.
«Fatti un'arca. Un diluvio sta arrivando.»

choices.text: [TODO:it] Receive God's command to build an ark of cypress wood
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis 6:14, 22 — God told Noah to make an ark of cypress wood, and Noah did everything just as God commanded.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Refuse the command and flee the land
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis says Noah obeyed God; he did not flee.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Buy an existing ship from a merchant
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis says Noah built the ark himself, as God instructed.

mockery.title: Un Mondo che Osserva
mockery.text:
Il mondo intorno a te è corrotto e violento.
Ti osservano costruire. Come rispondi?

choices.text: [TODO:it] Keep building the ark by faith
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Hebrews 11:7 — By faith Noah built the ark in reverent fear, though warned of things not yet seen.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Abandon the ark to please the crowd
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Scripture says Noah kept building by faith.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Attack the mockers to silence them
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Scripture does not describe Noah attacking anyone.

building.title: Cipresso e Pece
building.text:
Raccogli i materiali che Dio ha comandato.
Come costruisci l'arca?

choices.text: [TODO:it] Build it of cypress wood, coated with pitch inside and out
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis 6:14 — Make yourself an ark of cypress wood; coat it with pitch inside and out.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Build it from cut stone
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis says the ark was built of cypress wood, not stone.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Weave it from reeds like a basket
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis says the ark was made of cypress wood, sealed with pitch.

ark_done.title: È Finita
ark_done.text:
L'arca è completa, esattamente come Dio ha comandato.
Che aspetto ha?

choices.text: [TODO:it] 300 cubits long, 50 wide, 30 high, with three decks
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis 6:15-16 — The ark was 300 cubits long, 50 wide, 30 high, with three decks.

choices.text: [TODO:it] A small round boat with one deck
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis gives specific dimensions; the ark was not a small round boat.

choices.text: [TODO:it] A raft, flat and open to the sky
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis says the ark had a roof, three decks, and a door in its side.

animals.title: Le Creature Vengono
animals.text:
Gli animali arrivano all'arca.
Chi porti a bordo?

choices.text: [TODO:it] Take pairs of every kind of animal, male and female
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis 7:8-9 — Pairs of clean and unclean animals, birds and creeping things came to Noah, male and female.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Take only sheep and goats
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis says every kind of animal came, not only sheep and goats.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Take no animals — only your family
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis says the animals came into the ark with Noah.

boarding.title: La Porta Chiusa
boarding.text:
È tempo di entrare nell'arca.
Chi entra e chi chiude la porta?

choices.text: [TODO:it] Enter with your wife, three sons, and their wives; the Lord shuts the door
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis 7:13, 16 — Noah, his wife, his three sons and their wives entered the ark, and the Lord shut him in.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Enter the ark alone, leaving your family behind
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis says Noah's whole household entered the ark with him.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Stay outside and close the door from without
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis says the Lord Himself shut Noah inside the ark.

storm.title: Quaranta Giorni di Pioggia
storm.text:
Le finestre del cielo si aprono.
Che succede?

choices.text: [TODO:it] Rain falls on the earth for forty days and forty nights
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis 7:12 — Rain fell on the earth forty days and forty nights.

choices.text: [TODO:it] A single storm passes in one day
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis says the rain fell for forty days and nights.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Only a light drizzle falls
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis describes the fountains of the deep bursting and the windows of heaven opening.

inside.title: Sulle Acque
inside.text:
L'arca galleggia sul profondo.
Per quanto tempo le acque prevalgono sulla terra?

choices.text: [TODO:it] The waters flood the earth for a hundred and fifty days
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis 7:24 — The waters flooded the earth for a hundred and fifty days.

choices.text: [TODO:it] The waters recede in three days
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis says the waters prevailed 150 days before receding.

choices.text: [TODO:it] You steer the ark back toward Eden
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis does not describe Noah steering the ark; God kept it afloat.

dove.title: La Colomba Ritorna
dove.text:
Le acque iniziano a ritirarsi.
Come sai che la terra asciutta è vicina?

choices.text: [TODO:it] Send out a dove; it returns with a fresh olive leaf
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis 8:11 — The dove returned to Noah in the evening with a freshly plucked olive leaf.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Send out a raven that returns with grain
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis says the dove — not the raven — brought back an olive leaf.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Open the roof and look with your own eyes only
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis says Noah sent out birds to test whether the waters had gone down.

dry_land.title: Terra Sotto i Tuoi Piedi
dry_land.text:
Il Signore ti dice di uscire dall'arca.
Cosa fai per prima cosa sulla terra asciutta?

choices.text: [TODO:it] Build an altar to the Lord and offer sacrifices
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis 8:20 — Noah built an altar to the Lord and offered burnt offerings on it.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Begin building a great tower right away
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis says Noah's first act was to build an altar, not a tower.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Refuse to leave the ark
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Genesis says Noah came out of the ark when God told him to.

covenant.title: L'Arcobaleno
covenant.text:
Un arcobaleno si inarca nel cielo.
«Mai più inonderò la terra. Questo è il mio patto con te.»
